info.title: Kiruna Bus application API
info.description: Same-origin website API, independent of Boreal's upstream contract. Cached basic information is not live data. Live GPS fixes expire after three minutes. Public data does not require authentication; requests and upstream work are bounded.

get.summary: Basic map catalog without waiting for upstream
get.description: Returns a validated bundled or refreshed catalog. ETag revalidation is supported. X-Server-Time is the current response time, including on 304, and is separate from catalog.capturedAt.

get.summary: Read the cached live snapshot and register collector activity
get.description: Never waits for or starts a request-specific upstream fetch. Live HTTP reads keep the shared collector active for 120 seconds; SSE connections also keep it active. A successful response can be partial or stale: inspect quality and original GPS timestamps. generatedAt is response assembly time, not data freshness. epoch identifies the process, revision orders dynamic publications within that epoch, and catalogVersion identifies static content. A successful empty scan is distinct from a 503 unknown live picture.

get.summary: Subscribe to complete live snapshots over server-sent events
get.description: Keeps the shared collector active until disconnected. Immediately sends a full cached buses event or tracking-status when tracking is warming/unavailable; completed collection cycles publish subsequent events. IDs are epoch:revision. Last-Event-ID is not replayed: every connection resynchronizes with the current full snapshot. Heartbeat comments arrive every 15 seconds and do not establish data freshness or reset the browser's 60-second snapshot watchdog. Status-only events do not reset it either. Connections and slow-reader buffers are bounded; shutdown closes streams.

200.description: Incremental UTF-8 SSE frames. Named events have JSON data matching the event schemas below. Headers disable caching/transformation and request proxy buffering to be disabled.

get.description: Registers live-client activity and reads the collector's complete per-stop calls cache without contacting the source. Includes cancellation and disruption messages. Failed refreshes retain last-good data as state=stale for at most three minutes from original updatedAt. Missing or expired data returns 503 with Retry-After. Browser display expires at the same boundary.

Error.description: Structured error. 400 invalid request, 404 unknown resource, 405 wrong method, 413 body too large, 415 unsupported media, 429 rate limit, 502 invalid/unavailable upstream, 503 warming/overload, 504 upstream timeout. Retry-After is seconds where supplied. Methods and unknown/repeated query parameters are validated.
